How It Works

48 hours. Three steps. Done.

No discovery phases, no six-week timelines, no surprise invoices. Order today, review your draft tomorrow, launch the day after.

Today

Tell us about your business

A 15-minute call or a simple form. Send your logo, photos, and services — or just point us at your Facebook page and we'll pull what we need.

Tomorrow

Review your draft site

We send a private link to your finished draft. Love it? Say the word and we go live. Want changes? You get 3 design revisions — each one adds 2 days to the build.

Day After

Your site goes live

We connect your domain, set up your contact form, and hand you the keys. Customers can find you, call you, and reach you — in 48 hours.

How the clock works: the timer pauses whenever the site is in your hands for review, and starts again when you tell us to revise or go live. Take a day or a week to look it over — you're never rushed, and it never counts against your 48 hours.

What's Included

Everything a local business actually needs.

No bloated plugins. No page builders that break. Just a fast, secure site that does its job: getting customers to contact you.

  • Up to 7 professionally designed pages
  • Contact form delivered straight to your email
  • Click-to-call buttons and Google Maps
  • Photo galleries, service lists, and reviews
  • Mobile-ready and fast on every connection
  • Google-friendly structure so customers find you

Why so fast?

We build static websites — the same modern approach used by top tech companies. No database to hack, no updates to babysit, nothing to slow it down.

< 1s

Typical load time. Fast sites keep visitors, and Google ranks them higher. Your six-week WordPress site can't say that.
